en: Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is unwholesome but not associated with consciousness, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither indeterminate nor associated with consciousness...

A state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arise states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness and neither-indeterminate-nor-associated-with-consciousness by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arise states that are neither-wholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness and neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness... [and so forth].
They arise by way of root condition... five.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with consciousness by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is not wholesome and not associated with consciousness... [and so forth].

[An unwholesome state] arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, a neutral state not associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, both a wholesome state not associated with consciousness and a neutral state not associated with consciousness arise by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness...
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness, states that are neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness arise by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on an indeterminate state associated with consciousness, a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness arises.

By way of root condition: dependent on an indeterminate state associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with consciousness, by way of root condition.

Dependent on an indeterminate state associated with consciousness, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor associated with consciousness and neither unwholesome nor associated with consciousness, by way of root condition... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-cause condition, there are thirteen; in the case of object condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition, three ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, thirteen.
